objective: Build a throwaway spike that runs Pi's bash tool contract on just-bash with host passthrough and TS/JS execution, and measure on Linux which required behaviours work.
scope: Work only in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/spike (a scratch folder outside every repository): its own package.json, `bun add just-bash@3.6.0` (exact) there, and a Bun TypeScript harness. Nothing goes into any repository or worktree.

Background (read): /home/user/holyagent/.git/holyagent/reports/assignment-0mw96lmlw-w85v.md (just-bash API: customCommands/defineCommand, ctx.origCommand, ReadWriteFs, exec options, js-exec, no streaming, env and cwd reset per exec, cooperative cancel, maxExecutionTimeMs 30s) and /home/user/holyagent/.git/holyagent/reports/assignment-0mw96qjlf-o4zi.md (Billion Context's bash guardrails). Pi's contract is BashOperations.exec(command, cwd, {onData, signal, timeout, env}) => Promise<{exitCode}> in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-t3host/node_modules/.bun/@earendil-works+pi-coding-agent@1.5.0+8980da4117b98cd5/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/core/tools/bash.d.ts:35-52; implement that signature (import the type from that path or copy it).

Decided design to spike: (1) just-bash on ReadWriteFs over the real filesystem so host programs and just-bash see the same files at the same paths; (2) commands just-bash implements run as its built-ins (they win over PATH); every other executable found on PATH (and ~/.bun/bin, ~/.local/bin and mise shims if present) is registered as a custom command that spawns the real program with argv, cwd, env and stdin, kills its process tree on ctx.signal, and returns stdout, stderr and the exit code; (3) env, exported variables and cwd persist across exec() calls in the adapter; (4) a command line that is exactly one host program streams its output to onData while running (bypass or side channel), and mixed lines deliver output at the end; (5) Pi's timeout is honoured and just-bash's maxExecutionTimeMs is raised to match; (6) TypeScript first: strip types with Bun.Transpiler and run in just-bash's js-exec; if stripping fails, run as JavaScript.

Run each case and record pass or fail with the observed output: (a) `git -C /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-t3branch log --oneline -3`; (b) `bun --version` and `bunx --no-install mise --version`; (c) the real long gate `cd /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-t3branch && bunx --no-install mise run verify` (must exit 0 and stream output while running; record the time to first output); (d) the holyagent CLI `bun --no-env-file --config=/root/.claude/plugins/synced/03eb801d-6ff6-4373-b5b1-f94edf359a3e_0f3e6ee9-af2e-4c2c-8d3c-9be25ca27713/holyagent/scripts/empty-bunfig.toml /root/.claude/plugins/synced/03eb801d-6ff6-4373-b5b1-f94edf359a3e_0f3e6ee9-af2e-4c2c-8d3c-9be25ca27713/holyagent/scripts/holyagent.js help`; (e) persistence: `cd /tmp && export SPIKE=1` in one call, then `pwd; echo $SPIKE` in the next; (f) a mixed pipe `git -C /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-t3branch log --oneline -20 | grep feat | head -3`; (g) a timeout of 2s on `sleep 30` run as a host program and on a just-bash loop; (h) cancel through an AbortSignal during a host `sleep 30` and confirm no child process survives (check with ps); (i) redirection to a file then reading it with the host `cat` and the built-in; (j) a TypeScript snippet with type annotations and a plain JavaScript one, plus a TS snippet that fails to strip falling back to JS; (k) a binary-safe case (pipe a small gzip file through a host program). Also note what the Windows and macOS paths would need (drive letters, PATHEXT, .cmd shims) from reading the code; they cannot run here.
